campaign_name: Repeals 'Top Two' Open Primary Election Process (AG 26-0004 / SOS #2022, 'Undo the Top Two')
purpose: Repeal California's top-two open primary system adopted by voters in 2010
sponsor: Proponent: Steven Maviglio (Democratic consultant). Supporters named by proponent include California Labor Federation, Greens, Carl DeMaio, a former Republican Party chair
deadline: 2027-01-11 (end of 180-day circulation period; submit to county elections officials)
signatures_collected: unknown (CA SOS 25%-signature list showed 'None at this time' when checked)

Check Cal-Access for the committee's payments to petition firms. No 25% report filed as of check.
